authority: V5.2 Part 140 Gate 15 (operational assurance); V5.1 Parts 26, 29, 98, 100
producedBy: Workforce stream B (SRE/platform-architect subagent), coordinated under MISSION-0002 Gate 15 Operational Assurance Closure
purpose: Close the two previously notAssessed Gate 15 dimensions (deployment, operational-runtime) with an evidence-backed inventory and explicitly classified remaining work.

implemented: Build pipeline: vite build producing dist/client + dist/server (nitro SSR entry)
CI verify workflow: npm ci, Node 22, npm run verify on PR and push (.github/workflows/verify.yml)
CI infrastructure-verify: credential-free structural validation (terraform fmt/validate, kubeconform, supabase-config-check)
CI infrastructure plan/apply: manual workflow_dispatch, approval-gated GitHub Environment, APPLY confirmation word, credentials from Environments never commits (authored, never executed)
Env contract: .env.example plus frontend/src/lib/env.ts required-vars matrix with VITE_ secret-exposure guard (verify:env)
Secret scanning: scripts/verification/secret-scan.mjs in the verify pipeline
definedButNotImplemented: Terraform IaC: 5 provider roots (oci, hetzner, vultr, cloudflare, supabase) plus production composition; self-declared 'Authored - not applied'
Kubernetes baseline: namespaces, default-deny network policies, resource governance, RBAC; structural only, no cluster
Monitoring signal contract: metrics 30d / logs 30d / traces 7d / SLO error budget; explicitly 'Not deployed'
missing: HTTP health-check endpoint (no /health, /healthz, or /metrics route exists anywhere)
App deployment workflow: CI verifies but never deploys or publishes the app artifact; nothing between 'CI passes' and 'serving'
requirementsForFullAssessment: A deployment target running the existing artifacts with recorded build-artifact hash and reachable URL
A release workflow or documented runbook step promoting the built artifact
Env contract applied on target with ALLOW_DEMO_PROVISIONING=false and verify:env passing (redacted evidence)
Migrations applied on target with db-apply output plus passing RLS isolation check
IaC assessed at structural validity only until provider credentials exist

operationalRuntimeDimension.assessed: PARTIALLY (failure-handling and audit patterns strong; observability surface absent)
implemented: House pattern for idempotent execution + replay: foundation-loop.functions.ts upsert on (tenant_id, mission_id, version) with duplicate-key replay of prior verification
Governed rollback: tenant-scope check (cross-tenant fails closed with identical signal), admitted-only guard, rolled_back/compensation_required, append-only history, audit_logs record
Central audit logging via frontend/src/lib/audit.ts (never-throw best-effort) backed by audit_logs table
Webhook signature validation: Paystack HMAC-SHA512 over raw body with 401 on mismatch
Resilience primitives: in-process rate limiter (user/tenant/api/service/integration/agent scopes), circuit breaker, retry engine
SSR error surface: errorComponent + notFoundComponent wired in __root.tsx; custom server.ts fallback for catastrophic failures
DB migrations: 44 ordered files, env-only DATABASE_URL, stop-on-first-failure, dry-run helper
partiallyImplemented: Logging: console.error only; error capture is a 5s-TTL in-memory last-error; no structured logs, request IDs, or levels
DB rollback strategy: forward-only compensating-migration policy defined; database/supabase/rollbacks/ exists but is empty (zero compensating migrations authored)
missing: Metrics/tracing: no application /metrics endpoint, no OpenTelemetry hooks
Health/liveness probes for the app process
Security headers/CORS at the app edge (no CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options; enforcement implied at Supabase/edge only)
requirementsForFullAssessment: A minimal /_health server route plus a probe-running target returning HTTP 200
Process supervision evidence (systemd unit, container restart policy, or equivalent)
One exemplar compensating migration exercised against a live database
Demonstrated log capture (stdout from server.ts) plus audit_logs rows written during a smoke exercise

missingItemDispositions.rationale: Provider credentials not supplied; infrastructure/CREDENTIALS.md documents the gap
Intended runtime documented (nitro bundle); containerization matters once a cluster target exists
Signal contract defined; backend stack choice gated on an owner ADR
Small code change, but meaningless until a probe-running target exists
Correct owner is the unapplied Cloudflare root or k8s ingress; app-level config would be duplicate policy
Forward-only policy; at least one exemplar needed for Gate 15 closure
Matters only under a long-lived managed runtime

risksRecorded.finding: scripts/db-apply.mjs sets ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } (MITM-tolerant DB connection). Proposed governed fix: enable certificate verification against the Supabase CA.
Audit logging is best-effort and silently swallowed; logAudit uses the anon (client-side) client so audit writes depend on RLS permitting them, and failures are indistinguishable from success.
Rate limiting is in-process (resets on restart, does not bound across replicas); only the password-reset route applies a limit.
dist/ is the only build proof (gitignored, ephemeral in CI); verified artifact and deployed artifact can diverge.
Post-apply 'health check' in infrastructure-plan-apply.yml is an echo statement that checks nothing.
